title: 雷射散斑抑制~Laser-speckle reduction
focus: 散斑統計、1/√N 多樣性預算、移動擴散片、光纖去同調、等效人眼量測與投影光展量限制~Speckle statistics, 1/√N diversity budgets, moving diffusers, fiber decoherence, eye-equivalent measurement and projector étendue limits
summary: 從雷射照在粗糙屏幕上的隨機相量和出發，理解散斑對比 C = σ/⟨I⟩ 為何只能靠疊加獨立圖樣以 1/√N 降低，再把角度、偏振與波長多樣性、移動擴散片、多模光纖、等效人眼相機、投影鏡頭光展量與壽命驗收整合成可交接的散斑抑制工程。~Start from the random phasor sum of laser light on a rough screen to see why speckle contrast C = σ/⟨I⟩ falls only as 1/√N by stacking independent patterns, then integrate angle, polarization and wavelength diversity, moving diffusers, multimode fibers, eye-equivalent cameras, projection-lens étendue and lifetime acceptance into a transferable speckle-reduction record.

units.anchor: 屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔~Screen roughness and observer pupil
units.title: 散斑的形成與統計~Speckle formation and statistics
units.mechanism: 同調光照到粗糙度大於波長的屏幕時，觀察者每個解析單元內都有大量隨機相位的散射子波，它們在視網膜或感測器上做複數相加，形成隨機相量和。當相位完全隨機且散射子很多時，強度服從負指數分布，散斑對比 C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1，稱為完全發展的散斑；去偏振屏幕把光分成兩個獨立偏振的散斑圖，C 降到 1/√2。人眼看到的是主觀散斑，顆粒大小由觀察者瞳孔而非屏幕決定，所以同一畫面在明亮環境下瞳孔縮小時，散斑更粗、更明顯。~When coherent light strikes a screen rougher than a wavelength, every resolution cell of the observer contains many scattered wavelets of random phase that add as complex amplitudes on the retina or sensor, forming a random phasor sum. With fully random phases and many scatterers the intensity follows a negative-exponential distribution and the speckle contrast C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1, called fully developed speckle; a depolarizing screen splits the light into two independent polarization patterns and C falls to 1/√2. The eye sees subjective speckle whose grain size is set by the observer's pupil rather than the screen, so the same picture shows coarser, more visible speckle in bright surroundings where the pupil contracts.
units.model: 完全發展散斑 P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩：亮度超過平均 3 倍的面積佔 e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%，低於平均 10% 的暗點佔 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%。主觀散斑投回屏幕的顆粒直徑 ≈ 2.44λL/D：λ = 532 nm、觀看距離 L = 3 m、瞳孔 D = 3 mm 時 ≈ 1.30 mm，比眼睛 1 角分在 3 m 處對應的 0.87 mm 還大，因此清楚可見；瞳孔放大到 6 mm 時縮為 0.65 mm。~For fully developed speckle P(I) = exp(−I/⟨I⟩)/⟨I⟩: the area brighter than three times the mean is e⁻³ ≈ 5.0%, and dark spots below 10% of the mean cover 1 − e^(−0.1) ≈ 9.5%. The subjective grain diameter projected back onto the screen is ≈ 2.44λL/D: with λ = 532 nm, viewing distance L = 3 m and pupil D = 3 mm it is ≈ 1.30 mm, larger than the 0.87 mm that one arcminute of eye resolution spans at 3 m, so it is clearly visible; a 6 mm pupil shrinks it to 0.65 mm.
units.verify: 以單模綠光雷射照亮白色擴散屏，用單色相機在 3 m 處、入瞳直徑 3 mm、對焦於屏面拍攝，計算中央區塊的 σ/⟨I⟩ 與強度直方圖，加檢偏器時應接近負指數分布且 C ≈ 1，去偏振屏不加檢偏器時 C ≈ 0.71；再改變入瞳直徑，確認顆粒大小與 1/D 成正比。~Illuminate a white diffusing screen with a single-mode green laser and photograph it with a monochrome camera at 3 m with a 3 mm entrance pupil focused on the screen; compute σ/⟨I⟩ and the intensity histogram of a central block, which with an analyser should approach a negative exponential with C ≈ 1 and on a depolarizing screen without analyser give C ≈ 0.71; then vary the entrance-pupil diameter and confirm that grain size scales as 1/D.
units.failure: 在暗室評估時觀察者瞳孔約 6 mm，散斑細到難以察覺而判定合格；產品裝進明亮大廳後瞳孔縮到 2 到 3 mm，顆粒變粗一倍以上，畫面出現閃爍砂粒感，客訴才出現。~Evaluated in a dark room with observer pupils near 6 mm, the speckle is too fine to notice and the design passes; installed in a bright lobby the pupils shrink to 2 to 3 mm, the grain more than doubles, the picture takes on a sparkling sandy texture and only then do complaints arrive.
units.misconception: 散斑是屏幕上固定的圖案，從任何位置看都一樣。~Speckle is a fixed pattern on the screen and looks the same from anywhere.

units.anchor: 角度、偏振與波長多樣性~Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity
units.title: 1/√N 平均律與多樣性預算~The 1/√N averaging law and the diversity budget
units.mechanism: 降低散斑的唯一途徑，是在觀察者的一個解析單元與一個積分時間內疊加 N 個彼此不相關、強度相近的散斑圖；強度相加使 C = 1/√N。獨立圖樣來自三種多樣性：照明角度（投影光瞳相對觀察者瞳孔的立體角比）、偏振（最多 2 個圖樣）與波長（光源頻寬相對屏幕路徑差所需的去相關波長）。三者相乘得總縮減因子 R = R_角·R_偏·R_λ，每一項都有物理上限，所以設計要先把目標 C 換算成所需的 N，再分配給各項。~The only way to lower speckle is to stack, within one observer resolution cell and one integration time, N mutually uncorrelated speckle patterns of similar intensity; intensity addition gives C = 1/√N. Independent patterns come from three diversities: illumination angle (the solid-angle ratio of projection pupil to observer pupil), polarization (at most two patterns) and wavelength (source bandwidth relative to the decorrelation wavelength set by the screen's path-length spread). They multiply into a total reduction factor R = R_angle·R_pol·R_λ, each with a physical ceiling, so design first converts the target C into the required N and then allocates it among the three.
units.model: 目標 C = 4%（教學假設）需 N = 1/0.04² = 625，R = 25。偏振 R_偏 = √2。波長：多發射體雷射頻寬 2 nm，同調長度 l_c = λ²/Δλ ≈ 142 µm；體擴散屏路徑差展開 0.5 mm 時 N_λ ≈ 500/142 ≈ 3.5，R_λ ≈ 1.88。剩下 R_角 = 25/(1.41×1.88) ≈ 9.4，N_角 ≈ 88；同距離下 R_角 = D_投/D_眼，3 mm 瞳孔要求投影光瞳被時變照明填滿至 28 mm。若屏幕只有 20 µm 表面散射，N_λ < 1，波長多樣性完全無效。~A target C = 4% (teaching assumption) needs N = 1/0.04² = 625, R = 25. Polarization gives R_pol = √2. For wavelength, a multi-emitter laser with 2 nm bandwidth has coherence length l_c = λ²/Δλ ≈ 142 µm; a volume-diffusing screen with 0.5 mm path spread gives N_λ ≈ 500/142 ≈ 3.5, R_λ ≈ 1.88. That leaves R_angle = 25/(1.41×1.88) ≈ 9.4, N_angle ≈ 88; at equal distances R_angle = D_proj/D_eye, so a 3 mm pupil demands a projection pupil filled with time-varying illumination out to 28 mm. A surface-only screen with 20 µm spread gives N_λ < 1 and wavelength diversity does nothing.
units.verify: 分項量測：比較加與不加檢偏器的 C，比值應接近 √2；以光譜儀量光源頻寬，在同一屏幕上比較單模與多發射體光源的 C；以可變光闌改變照明光瞳直徑，畫 C 對 D_投 的曲線，應隨 1/D_投 下降，直到積分時間內的獨立圖樣不足而飽和。~Measure each term: compare C with and without an analyser, expecting a ratio near √2; measure source bandwidth with a spectrometer and compare C for single-mode and multi-emitter sources on the same screen; vary the illumination pupil with an iris and plot C against D_proj, which should fall as 1/D_proj until too few independent patterns fit in the integration time and it saturates.
units.failure: 設計只看光源頻寬：同一顆 2 nm 光源在體擴散屏上合格，換成表面金屬化的保偏 3D 銀幕後波長與偏振多樣性同時消失，C 回升約 2.7 倍，直到影院現場安裝才發現。~The design looked only at source bandwidth: the same 2 nm source passes on a volume-diffusing screen, but on a metallized polarization-preserving 3D silver screen both wavelength and polarization diversity vanish and C rises about 2.7-fold, discovered only at cinema installation.
units.misconception: 只要雷射頻寬夠寬，就不必在意屏幕與投影光學。~A broad enough laser bandwidth makes screen and projection optics irrelevant.

units.anchor: 移動擴散片與相關長度~Moving diffuser and correlation length
units.title: 移動擴散片與時間平均~Moving diffusers and temporal averaging
units.mechanism: 角度多樣性要在時間上實現，最常見的元件是放在中間像面或光瞳附近的移動擴散片：擴散片每移動一個相關長度，屏幕上的散斑就換成一個新的獨立圖樣。旋轉擴散片速度高，但體積大且有軸承壽命問題；以電活性聚合物膜驅動的小型擴散片用 x、y 兩組電極以 90° 相位差產生圓周運動，避免線性往返在折返點停頓並重走相同路徑。關鍵在於：時間上的圖樣再多，有效 N 仍受投影光瞳能容納的角度數 N_角 封頂。~Angle diversity has to be delivered in time, most often by a moving diffuser near an intermediate image or pupil: each time the diffuser moves one correlation length the screen speckle becomes a new independent pattern. Rotating diffusers are fast but bulky and limited by bearing life; compact diffusers on electroactive-polymer membranes drive x and y electrodes 90° apart in phase to produce circular motion, avoiding the stall at the turning points of a linear stroke and the retracing of the same path. The key point is that however many patterns appear in time, the effective N is capped by the number of angles N_angle the projection pupil can hold.
units.model: 擴散片相關長度 δ = 20 µm。半徑 15 mm、3000 rpm 的旋轉擴散片 v = 4.71 m/s，50 ms 內掃過 v·T/δ ≈ 11 800 個圖樣，但有效 N 仍封頂於光瞳的 N_角（例如 88）。線性往返 0.6 mm 行程只會重走同一路徑，獨立圖樣上限 0.6/0.02 = 30；半徑 0.3 mm、300 Hz 的圓周運動每圈走 1.88 mm，上限約 94 個，但 1 ms 相機曝光內只有 0.565 m/s×1 ms/20 µm ≈ 28 個。~Take a diffuser correlation length δ = 20 µm. A rotating diffuser at 15 mm radius and 3000 rpm moves at v = 4.71 m/s and sweeps v·T/δ ≈ 11 800 patterns in 50 ms, yet the effective N stays capped at the pupil's N_angle (for example 88). A linear 0.6 mm stroke retraces one path, capping independent patterns at 0.6/0.02 = 30; a circular orbit of 0.3 mm radius at 300 Hz travels 1.88 mm per cycle for about 94 patterns, but a 1 ms camera exposure sees only 0.565 m/s×1 ms/20 µm ≈ 28.
units.verify: 以等效人眼相機在 1、5、20、50 ms 曝光下量 C，畫 C 對曝光內圖樣數的曲線，前段應依 1/√N 下降、後段飽和於角度上限；用高速相機或雷射都卜勒測振儀量擴散片軌跡與速度，確認圓周運動沒有退化成橢圓或直線。~Measure C with an eye-equivalent camera at 1, 5, 20 and 50 ms exposures and plot it against the number of patterns per exposure, which should first fall as 1/√N and then saturate at the angle ceiling; record the diffuser trajectory and speed with a high-speed camera or laser Doppler vibrometer to confirm the circular orbit has not degraded into an ellipse or a line.
units.failure: 驅動其中一軸的放大器老化，圓周退化成扁橢圓，短軸幾乎不動，獨立圖樣降到線性往返的 30 個，R_角 由 9.4 掉到 5.5，C 從 4% 慢慢升到約 6.8%；因為變化緩慢，沒有定期量測就只能等客戶抱怨。~An ageing amplifier on one axis flattens the circle into a thin ellipse whose minor axis barely moves, independent patterns drop to the 30 of a linear stroke, R_angle falls from 9.4 to 5.5 and C creeps from 4% to about 6.8%; because the change is gradual, without periodic measurement it is found only through customer complaints.
units.misconception: 擴散片轉得越快，散斑就可以無限降低。~Spinning the diffuser faster lowers speckle without limit.

units.anchor: 多模光纖與光源頻寬~Multimode fiber and source bandwidth
units.title: 光源工程與多模光纖去同調~Source engineering and multimode-fiber decoherence
units.mechanism: 另一條路是讓光源本身攜帶多樣性：多發射體雷射二極體陣列天生有波長分散，調變驅動電流也能展寬譜線；多模光纖則把光分到數以萬計的模態，各模態的群速度不同。但模態彼此仍是同調的，只有當模態間的最大光程差大於光源同調長度時，光纖出口才會變成多個互不相干的散斑圖，所以單頻雷射進多模光纖依舊滿是散斑。階躍折射率光纖的模態色散遠大於漸變折射率光纖，在去散斑用途上反而是優點。~Another route is to make the source carry diversity itself: multi-emitter laser-diode arrays have an inherent wavelength spread and modulated drive current can broaden the line, while a multimode fiber divides the light among tens of thousands of modes with different group velocities. The modes are still mutually coherent, though, and the fiber output becomes many mutually incoherent speckle patterns only when the maximum intermodal path difference exceeds the source coherence length, so a single-frequency laser in a multimode fiber still emerges full of speckle. Step-index fiber has far more modal dispersion than graded-index fiber, which here is an advantage.
units.model: 芯徑 400 µm、NA 0.22、λ = 532 nm：V = 2πa·NA/λ ≈ 520，模態數 ≈ V²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁵。10 m 階躍光纖模態光程差 ΔL = L·NA²/(2n) = 10×0.0484/2.92 ≈ 166 mm；2 nm 光源 l_c ≈ 142 µm，N ≈ 166/0.142 ≈ 1170，C ≈ 2.9%。單頻雷射 Δλ = 1 pm 時 l_c ≈ 283 mm > 166 mm，N ≈ 1。同長度漸變折射率光纖 ΔL ≈ L·NA⁴/(8n³) ≈ 0.94 mm，N ≈ 6.6，C ≈ 39%。~For a 400 µm core, NA 0.22 and λ = 532 nm, V = 2πa·NA/λ ≈ 520 and the mode count ≈ V²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁵. A 10 m step-index fiber has intermodal path spread ΔL = L·NA²/(2n) = 10×0.0484/2.92 ≈ 166 mm; a 2 nm source with l_c ≈ 142 µm gives N ≈ 166/0.142 ≈ 1170 and C ≈ 2.9%. A single-frequency laser with Δλ = 1 pm has l_c ≈ 283 mm > 166 mm, so N ≈ 1. The same length of graded-index fiber gives ΔL ≈ L·NA⁴/(8n³) ≈ 0.94 mm, N ≈ 6.6 and C ≈ 39%.
units.verify: 把光纖出口端面成像到相機，分別以單頻與多發射體光源量近場散斑對比；改變光纖長度（2、5、10 m）畫 C 對 1/√L 的曲線；以光譜儀確認光源頻寬並計算 l_c，與量得的有效 N 比較。~Image the fiber output face onto a camera and measure near-field speckle contrast with single-frequency and multi-emitter sources; vary fiber length (2, 5 and 10 m) and plot C against 1/√L; confirm source bandwidth with a spectrometer, compute l_c and compare with the measured effective N.
units.failure: 為提高耦合效率改用漸變折射率光纖，均勻度報告依舊漂亮（因為只量了平均功率），但機器視覺相機在 1 ms 曝光下看到 30% 以上的照明散斑，邊緣定位抖動數個像素。~Graded-index fiber is substituted to raise coupling efficiency and the uniformity report still looks fine because it measured only average power, but a machine-vision camera at 1 ms exposure sees over 30% illumination speckle and edge positions jitter by several pixels.
units.misconception: 用多模光纖傳光，輸出就一定是非同調、無散斑的。~Light through a multimode fiber always emerges incoherent and speckle-free.

units.anchor: 等效人眼散斑相機~Eye-equivalent speckle camera
units.title: 散斑對比的量測方法~Measuring speckle contrast
units.mechanism: 散斑對比不是屏幕或光源的固有數字，而是對特定偵測器定義的量：偵測器孔徑決定顆粒大小與能收集多少角度多樣性，像素大小決定空間積分，曝光時間決定時間平均。要評估人眼感受，量測相機必須模擬眼睛：放在觀看位置、入瞳直徑等於瞳孔、對焦於屏面、每個顆粒至少兩個像素取樣、曝光接近眼睛的積分時間。任何一項不匹配都會讓 C 被系統性高估或低估，而且不同實驗室的數字無法比較。~Speckle contrast is not an intrinsic number of a screen or source but a quantity defined for a particular detector: the detector aperture sets grain size and how much angle diversity is collected, pixel size sets spatial integration and exposure time sets temporal averaging. To judge what the eye sees, the measuring camera must emulate the eye: placed at the viewing position, with an entrance pupil equal to the eye pupil, focused on the screen, sampling each grain with at least two pixels and exposing for about the eye's integration time. Any mismatch biases C systematically up or down and makes numbers from different laboratories incomparable.
units.model: 3 m 處用 f = 50 mm 鏡頭、入瞳 3 mm，F 數 = 50/3 ≈ 16.7；感測器上散斑直徑 ≈ 2.44λF = 2.44×0.532×16.7 ≈ 21.6 µm，3.45 µm 像素可取 6.3 個像素，取樣充足。若改用 F/2.8，入瞳 17.9 mm，散斑只剩 3.6 µm 約一個像素，像素積分會壓低 C；同時入瞳變大也改變角度多樣性的分母，兩個偏差方向相反，結果失去意義。~At 3 m a f = 50 mm lens with a 3 mm entrance pupil runs at F = 50/3 ≈ 16.7; the speckle diameter on the sensor is ≈ 2.44λF = 2.44×0.532×16.7 ≈ 21.6 µm, covering 6.3 pixels of 3.45 µm, ample sampling. At F/2.8 the entrance pupil is 17.9 mm and the speckle only 3.6 µm, about one pixel, so pixel integration depresses C; the larger pupil also changes the denominator of angle diversity, and the two biases act in opposite directions, leaving a meaningless result.
units.verify: 量測前先以單模雷射加檢偏器確認系統能量到 C ≈ 1（證明取樣足夠）；再以非同調 LED 照同一屏幕量 C，作為相機雜訊與屏幕紋理的底；每次量測記錄入瞳、F 數、像素大小、曝光時間與距離，比較只在相同設定下進行。~Before measuring, confirm with a single-mode laser and analyser that the system can read C ≈ 1, proving adequate sampling; then light the same screen with an incoherent LED and measure C as the floor from camera noise and screen texture; log entrance pupil, F-number, pixel size, exposure and distance with every measurement, and compare only like with like.
units.failure: 供應商報告寫散斑對比 2%，但量測用 F/2 鏡頭與 10 ms 曝光；以等效人眼設定重量得 6%。採購依報告數字比價，選中了實際最差的方案。~A supplier report quotes 2% speckle contrast measured with an F/2 lens and 10 ms exposure; re-measured with eye-equivalent settings it reads 6%, and purchasing, comparing reported numbers, selects the option that is actually worst.
units.misconception: 散斑對比是屏幕或光源的固有規格，與量測相機無關。~Speckle contrast is intrinsic to screen or source, independent of the measuring camera.

units.anchor: 對比雜訊預算與飽和曲線~Contrast noise budget and saturation
units.title: 量測誤差預算與部分相關~Measurement error budget and partial correlation
units.mechanism: 相機量得的對比是多個獨立變動來源的平方和：真正的散斑、散粒雜訊、像素響應不均（PRNU）與照明的低頻不均。要得到真正的散斑對比必須逐項估算並扣除；低頻不均可用高通濾波或局部平均正規化去除，但濾波尺度必須遠大於散斑顆粒，否則連散斑一起濾掉。另一個常被忽略的是部分相關：相鄰時間的圖樣若沒有完全去相關，有效 N 小於名目值，C 對曝光時間的曲線會比 1/√N 平緩並提早飽和。~The contrast a camera reads is a sum of squares of independent variations: true speckle, shot noise, pixel response non-uniformity (PRNU) and low-frequency illumination non-uniformity. Recovering the true speckle contrast means estimating and subtracting each term; low-frequency non-uniformity is removed by high-pass filtering or local-mean normalisation, with a filter scale far larger than the grain, otherwise speckle is filtered away too. Another often-ignored factor is partial correlation: if successive patterns are not fully decorrelated, the effective N is below nominal and the C-versus-exposure curve is shallower than 1/√N and saturates early.
units.model: C_量² = C_斑² + C_散粒² + C_PRNU² + C_照明²。量得 5.0%，平均訊號 20 000 e⁻ 給散粒 1/√20000 = 0.71%，PRNU 0.5%，高通後殘餘照明不均 1.0%：C_斑 = √(25 − 0.50 − 0.25 − 1.00) ≈ 4.82%。曝光由 5 ms 增到 50 ms，名目圖樣數增 10 倍，C 應降 √10 ≈ 3.16 倍；實測只降 1.6 倍，表示有效 N 只增 2.6 倍，已接近角度上限。~C_meas² = C_speckle² + C_shot² + C_PRNU² + C_illum². A reading of 5.0% with a mean signal of 20 000 e⁻ gives shot noise 1/√20000 = 0.71%, PRNU 0.5% and residual illumination non-uniformity after high-pass 1.0%: C_speckle = √(25 − 0.50 − 0.25 − 1.00) ≈ 4.82%. Raising exposure from 5 ms to 50 ms multiplies nominal patterns tenfold, so C should drop by √10 ≈ 3.16; a measured drop of only 1.6 means the effective N grew just 2.6-fold, close to the angle ceiling.
units.verify: 在同一位置以 LED 照明量 C_底（含散粒、PRNU 與屏幕紋理），與雷射量測做平方相減；以多張不同時刻的影像確認散粒項；把 C 對曝光時間畫在雙對數座標，與斜率 −0.5 比較，標出飽和點並記錄。~Measure C_floor at the same position under LED illumination (shot noise, PRNU and screen texture) and subtract it in quadrature from the laser reading; confirm the shot-noise term from several frames taken at different moments; plot C against exposure on log-log axes, compare with a −0.5 slope, and mark and record the saturation point.
units.failure: 沒有扣除屏幕紋理與 PRNU，在真實 C = 2% 的系統上量到 2.4%，團隊誤以為還要再加一級擴散片，結果多損失 8% 光通量卻沒有任何可見改善。~Without subtracting screen texture and PRNU, a system whose true C is 2% reads 2.4%, the team concludes another diffuser stage is needed and loses 8% more flux with no visible improvement.
units.misconception: 影像標準差除以平均值，就是散斑對比。~Image standard deviation over mean is the speckle contrast.

units.anchor: 投影鏡頭光瞳與振動屏幕~Projection pupil and vibrating screen
units.title: 投影系統整合與光展量限制~Projector integration and étendue limits
units.mechanism: 散斑抑制最後要放進真實的投影機：照明的發散角受 DMD 或 LCOS 接受角與投影鏡頭 F 數限制，擴散片產生的角度若超出投影鏡頭的光展量就會被裁掉，變成光損而不是散斑改善。因此 R_角 的上限其實是投影鏡頭出瞳對屏幕的張角與觀察者瞳孔張角之比，與擴散片多強無關。要再往下降，只能在屏幕端加入多樣性（振動屏幕）、擴大波長分布，或在 RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉架構間取捨：螢光粉轉換出的光是寬頻非同調光，本身幾乎沒有散斑。~Speckle reduction must finally fit inside a real projector: illumination divergence is limited by the DMD or LCOS acceptance angle and the projection-lens F-number, and any diffuser angle beyond the lens étendue is clipped, turning into light loss rather than speckle improvement. The ceiling on R_angle is therefore the ratio of the angle the projection exit pupil subtends at the screen to that of the observer pupil, regardless of diffuser strength. Going lower requires diversity at the screen (a vibrating screen), a wider wavelength spread, or a trade between RGB pure-laser and laser-phosphor architectures, since phosphor-converted light is broadband and incoherent and carries almost no speckle.
units.model: f = 30 mm、F/2.4 投影鏡頭出瞳 12.5 mm，投射與觀看距離都 3 m、瞳孔 3 mm：R_角 = 12.5/3 ≈ 4.17，乘上 R_偏 = 1.41、R_λ = 1.88 得 R ≈ 11.1，C ≈ 9.0%，達不到 4%。多發射體波長分布展寬到 6 nm：N_λ = 6/0.566 ≈ 10.6，R_λ ≈ 3.26，C ≈ 5.2%；再加上提供 2 個獨立圖樣的振動屏幕，C ≈ 5.2%/√2 ≈ 3.7%。~An f = 30 mm, F/2.4 projection lens has a 12.5 mm exit pupil; with throw and viewing distance both 3 m and a 3 mm pupil, R_angle = 12.5/3 ≈ 4.17, and with R_pol = 1.41 and R_λ = 1.88 the total R ≈ 11.1 and C ≈ 9.0%, missing 4%. Widening the multi-emitter spread to 6 nm gives N_λ = 6/0.566 ≈ 10.6, R_λ ≈ 3.26 and C ≈ 5.2%; adding a vibrating screen that contributes 2 independent patterns gives C ≈ 5.2%/√2 ≈ 3.7%.
units.verify: 在整機上以可變光闌改變照明光瞳填充率並量 C，確認光瞳填滿後 C 不再下降；同時量光通量，擴散角增加造成的損失應與光展量計算一致；振動屏幕開關前後量 C 與觀眾區噪音（dBA），評估可接受性。~On the complete projector vary the illumination pupil fill with an iris while measuring C, confirming that C stops falling once the pupil is full; measure flux at the same time, expecting losses from larger diffuser angles to match the étendue calculation; measure C and audience-area noise (dBA) with the vibrating screen on and off to judge acceptability.
units.failure: 為了把 C 再壓低而加大擴散角，超出 DMD 接受角的光被光闌擋掉，亮度掉 15% 而散斑幾乎不變；被擋下的光在機殼內變成熱與雜散光，畫面對比度也跟著下降。~To push C lower the diffuser angle is widened, light beyond the DMD acceptance angle is clipped by the stop, brightness drops 15% while speckle barely changes, and the clipped light becomes heat and stray light inside the housing that also lowers picture contrast.
units.misconception: 擴散片的擴散角越大，散斑抑制效果就越好。~A wider diffuser angle always gives better speckle reduction.

units.anchor: 驗收矩陣與壽命紀錄~Acceptance matrix and lifetime record
units.title: 系統驗收與工程交接~System acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 散斑驗收要涵蓋人眼與機器兩種觀察者：等效人眼相機（3 mm 入瞳、約 50 ms 曝光）評估觀感，短曝光工業相機（例如 1 ms）評估量測用途，兩者時間平均的圖樣數相差數十倍。驗收矩陣包含紅綠藍三色、屏幕多個位置與多個觀看角度，並記錄光源頻寬、擴散片軌跡與屏幕型號。移動件是散斑抑制系統的壽命瓶頸，交接資料要包含疲勞週期、噪音與失效時的退化特徵，因為擴散片一旦停止，散斑會立刻回到接近完全發展的水準。~Speckle acceptance must cover two kinds of observer: an eye-equivalent camera (3 mm entrance pupil, about 50 ms exposure) for perceived quality and a short-exposure industrial camera (for example 1 ms) for measurement use, whose time-averaged pattern counts differ by tens of times. The acceptance matrix covers red, green and blue, several screen positions and several viewing angles, and records source bandwidth, diffuser trajectory and screen model. Moving parts are the lifetime bottleneck of a speckle-reduction system, so the handoff must include fatigue cycles, acoustic noise and degradation signatures, because the moment a diffuser stops the speckle returns to nearly fully developed.
units.model: 門檻範例（等效人眼、50 ms）：綠 ≤ 4%、紅 ≤ 5%、藍 ≤ 6%，量得 3.8%、4.1%、5.2% 皆合格。1 ms 工業相機下振動屏幕幾乎不動，只剩光瞳與光源多樣性，綠光為 5.2%，需另訂機器視覺規格。300 Hz 擴散片運轉 20 000 小時累積 300×20 000×3600 ≈ 2.2×10¹⁰ 次循環，膜材與黏著層的疲勞驗證必須涵蓋這個量級。~Example thresholds (eye-equivalent, 50 ms): green ≤ 4%, red ≤ 5%, blue ≤ 6%, measured at 3.8%, 4.1% and 5.2%, all passing. With a 1 ms industrial camera the vibrating screen is effectively frozen, leaving only pupil and source diversity, and green reads 5.2%, so a separate machine-vision specification is required. A 300 Hz diffuser running 20 000 hours accumulates 300×20 000×3600 ≈ 2.2×10¹⁰ cycles, and fatigue qualification of membrane and adhesive must cover that order.
units.verify: 依固定順序：熱平衡後量光源頻寬；量擴散片軌跡；在 9 個屏幕位置 × 3 個觀看角 × 3 色量 C（50 ms 與 1 ms 兩組）；量振動屏幕噪音；切斷擴散片電源，確認監控系統能在 C 上升時發出警報。結果與模型預測並列，超出者記錄原因。~In a fixed order: measure source bandwidth after thermal settling; record the diffuser trajectory; measure C at 9 screen positions × 3 viewing angles × 3 colours at both 50 ms and 1 ms; measure vibrating-screen noise; cut power to the diffuser and confirm the monitor raises an alarm as C rises. Tabulate results beside model predictions and record causes for any exceedance.
units.failure: 驗收只在中央、正面量綠光，邊緣與斜角因屏幕增益分布使有效照明光瞳變小，C 高出 40%；交接又沒有擴散片監控與更換週期，擴散片停轉時現場立即出現整面閃爍砂粒，卻無人知道原因。~Acceptance measured green only at the centre and head-on, while at the edges and oblique angles the screen gain profile shrinks the effective illumination pupil and C is 40% higher; the handoff also lacked diffuser monitoring and replacement intervals, so when the diffuser stalls the whole picture sparkles and nobody on site knows why.
units.misconception: 在畫面中央量一次合格，整個畫面就都合格。~One passing measurement at screen centre means the whole picture passes.

example: 散斑預算練習：綠光 532 nm RGB 雷射投影機，F/2.4、f = 30 mm 鏡頭出瞳 12.5 mm，投射與觀看距離皆 3 m，觀察者瞳孔 3 mm，去偏振體擴散屏的路徑差展開 0.5 mm。R_角 = 12.5/3 ≈ 4.17，所需 N_角 = 4.17² ≈ 17；半徑 0.3 mm、300 Hz 圓周擴散片每圈可提供約 94 個圖樣，足以填滿。R_偏 = √2。多發射體光源頻寬 6 nm、去相關波長 λ²/0.5 mm ≈ 0.566 nm，N_λ ≈ 10.6，R_λ ≈ 3.26。總 R = 4.17×1.41×3.26 ≈ 19.2，C ≈ 5.2%；加上提供 2 個獨立圖樣的振動屏幕，C ≈ 3.7%，達到 4% 目標。等效人眼相機的量測底（散粒 0.71%、PRNU 0.5%、照明 1.0%）合計 1.32%，預期讀值 √(3.7² + 1.32²) ≈ 3.9%。1 ms 工業相機下振動屏幕失效，預期 5.2%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Speckle-budget exercise: a 532 nm green channel of an RGB laser projector with an F/2.4, f = 30 mm lens (12.5 mm exit pupil), throw and viewing distance both 3 m, a 3 mm observer pupil and a depolarizing volume-diffusing screen with 0.5 mm path spread. R_angle = 12.5/3 ≈ 4.17, needing N_angle = 4.17² ≈ 17 patterns; a circular diffuser of 0.3 mm radius at 300 Hz offers about 94 per cycle, enough to fill it. R_pol = √2. A multi-emitter source with 6 nm spread and a decorrelation wavelength of λ²/0.5 mm ≈ 0.566 nm gives N_λ ≈ 10.6 and R_λ ≈ 3.26. Total R = 4.17×1.41×3.26 ≈ 19.2 and C ≈ 5.2%; a vibrating screen contributing 2 independent patterns brings C to ≈ 3.7%, meeting the 4% target. The eye-equivalent camera floor (shot 0.71%, PRNU 0.5%, illumination 1.0%) totals 1.32%, so the expected reading is √(3.7² + 1.32²) ≈ 3.9%. With a 1 ms industrial camera the vibrating screen is ineffective and 5.2% is expected. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
history: 雷射在 1960 年問世後不久，研究者就注意到被照亮的粗糙表面布滿閃爍亮點；1962 至 1963 年 Rigden、Gordon 與 Oliver 等人描述了這種顆粒現象，史丹佛大學的 Joseph Goodman 隨後建立散斑的統計理論，並在 2007 年出版《Speckle Phenomena in Optics》專書。2002 年 Silicon Light Machines 的 Jahja Trisnadi 以角度、偏振與波長多樣性相乘的架構分析雷射投影的散斑抑制，並以 Hadamard 相位擴散片在光柵光閥投影機上把對比由約 70% 降到 8%；其後電活性聚合物振動擴散片等小型元件與 RGB 純雷射投影一同普及。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~Soon after the laser appeared in 1960, researchers noticed that illuminated rough surfaces were covered with sparkling spots; in 1962 and 1963 Rigden, Gordon and Oliver among others described the granularity, and Joseph Goodman at Stanford went on to build the statistical theory of speckle, later collected in his 2007 book Speckle Phenomena in Optics. In 2002 Jahja Trisnadi of Silicon Light Machines analysed speckle reduction in laser projection as a product of angle, polarization and wavelength diversity and used a Hadamard phase diffuser on a grating-light-valve projector to cut contrast from about 70% to 8%; compact devices such as electroactive-polymer oscillating diffusers then spread together with RGB pure-laser projection. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
